ticket.subject: Two-factor codes lost after phone change
ticket.body_text:
Hello,

Writing on behalf of Velloran SAS. I replaced my phone over the weekend and lost my authenticator app, so I cannot sign in anymore.

I am our on-call engineer this week, and I cannot see any alerts without signing in. I do not have my backup codes with me, and our admin does not know how to reset it.

We have a hard deadline tomorrow morning, so please treat this as urgent. Can you reset the two-factor setup on my account?

Thanks,
Tomasz

label_notes: clean access (access-new-phone): the on-call engineer cannot sign in and has no other way to see alerts, so P2; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
